title: Algorithms for Quantum Computation: Discrete Logarithms and Factoring
abstract: Introduces polynomial-time quantum algorithms for integer factorization and discrete logarithms, demonstrating exponential speedup over all known classical algorithms.

title: A Fast Quantum Mechanical Algorithm for Database Search
abstract: Presents a quantum algorithm that searches an unsorted database of N items in O(√N) time, providing a provably optimal quadratic speedup over classical search.

title: Quantum Cryptography: Public Key Distribution and Coin Tossing
abstract: Proposes the first quantum key distribution protocol (BB84), enabling two parties to establish a shared secret key with information-theoretic security guaranteed by quantum mechanics.

title: Quantum Theory, the Church-Turing Principle and the Universal Quantum Computer
abstract: Introduces the concept of a universal quantum computer and demonstrates that quantum mechanics enables computational capabilities beyond classical Turing machines.

title: A Variational Eigenvalue Solver on a Photonic Quantum Processor
abstract: Introduces the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) algorithm, a hybrid quantum-classical approach for finding ground state energies of molecular Hamiltonians on near-term quantum hardware.

title: A Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm
abstract: Proposes QAOA, a quantum algorithm designed for combinatorial optimization problems that uses alternating unitary operators and classical parameter optimization.

title: Quantum Supremacy Using a Programmable Superconducting Processor
abstract: Google's Sycamore processor performs a specific computational task in 200 seconds that would take a classical supercomputer approximately 10,000 years, demonstrating quantum computational advantage.

title: Good Quantum Error-Correcting Codes Exist
abstract: Proves that quantum error-correcting codes exist and provides construction methods, establishing the theoretical foundation for fault-tolerant quantum computation.

title: Quantum Algorithm for Linear Systems of Equations
abstract: Presents a quantum algorithm (HHL) that solves systems of linear equations exponentially faster than the best known classical algorithms, with applications to machine learning and simulation.

title: Teleporting an Unknown Quantum State via Dual Classical and Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen Channels
abstract: Introduces quantum teleportation: the transfer of an unknown quantum state from one location to another using shared entanglement and classical communication.

title: Surface Codes: Towards Practical Large-Scale Quantum Computation
abstract: Comprehensive review of surface codes as the leading candidate for scalable quantum error correction, with detailed threshold analysis and hardware implementation requirements.

title: Quantum Random Walks: An Introductory Overview
abstract: Provides an accessible introduction to quantum random walks on graphs, their properties, and their role as a universal computational primitive for quantum algorithms.

title: Quantum Computing in the NISQ Era and Beyond
abstract: Defines the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era and discusses what quantum computers with 50-100 qubits might achieve despite lacking full error correction.

title: Quantum Machine Learning: What Quantum Computing Means to Data Mining
abstract: Surveys the intersection of quantum computing and machine learning, covering quantum-enhanced versions of SVMs, clustering, PCA, and neural networks.

title: Barren Plateaus in Quantum Neural Network Training Landscapes
abstract: Identifies the barren plateau phenomenon in variational quantum circuits: gradients vanish exponentially with system size for random parameterized circuits, posing a fundamental challenge for QML.

title: Quantum Complexity Theory
abstract: Studies quantum computation from a complexity-theoretic perspective and develops an efficient universal quantum Turing machine, establishing foundational results for quantum complexity theory.

title: On the Power of Quantum Computation
abstract: Introduces Simon's algorithm and shows that a quantum computer can solve a structured problem exponentially faster than known classical probabilistic methods, providing an early demonstration of quantum computational advantage.

title: Quantum Measurements and the Abelian Stabilizer Problem
abstract: Presents a polynomial-time quantum algorithm for the Abelian stabilizer problem and describes a procedure for measuring eigenvalues of unitary operators, with applications including the quantum Fourier transform over finite Abelian groups.

title: Experimental Quantum Teleportation
abstract: Demonstrates the experimental teleportation of a quantum state using entangled photons and measurements, providing an early experimental realization of quantum teleportation.

title: Unpaired Majorana Fermions in Quantum Wires
abstract: Describes one-dimensional quantum systems with Majorana boundary states and shows how such systems can encode qubits with intrinsic protection against certain forms of decoherence.
